channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbekistan President reviews Andijan region's socio-economic development
item.description: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev chaired a meeting on Andijan region's socio-economic development, entrepreneurship support, and income growth. The region's economy grew 8.8% in the first half of the year, with positive trends in industry, services, and investment. The focus is on creating high-income jobs and improving public welfare.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan customs officers seize illegally imported cars from Korea
item.description: Kyrgyzstan's northern railway customs department has uncovered the illegal import of Toyota Camry and Bombardier Snow vehicles from South Korea. The vehicles were brought in without transit declarations or accompanying documents. The estimated damage, including penalties, amounts to over 923,000 soms, with the recovered amount doubling this sum.

item.title: WFP urges UN General Assembly not to forget Afghanistan's hunger crisis
item.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) called on the UN General Assembly to address the ongoing hunger and malnutrition crisis in Afghanistan. The organization highlighted that mothers are bringing malnourished children to clinics for assistance, emphasizing the urgent need for attention to vulnerable families.

item.title: Taliban member killed in attack claimed by Afghanistan Freedom Front
item.description: The Afghanistan Freedom Front claims responsibility for an attack on a Taliban patrol vehicle on the Kabul-Bagram highway, resulting in one Taliban member killed and two injured. The incident occurred on Wednesday evening in the Dasht-e Barchi district of Kabul. The group stated its forces sustained no casualties.

item.title: Taliban summon Pakistan's chargé d'affaires over alleged airstrikes and airspace violations
item.description: Afghanistan's Taliban government summoned Pakistan's chargé d'affaires to protest alleged Pakistani military airstrikes and airspace violations in several provinces. The Taliban condemned the attacks as a violation of national sovereignty and rejected claims that Afghan territory is used against Pakistan, calling it an attempt to distort facts and hide domestic failures.

item.title: Afghanistan summons Pakistani chargé d’affaires over latest airstrikes
item.description: Afghanistan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Pakistan’s chargé d’affaires to Kabul, lodging a strong protest against alleged Pakistani military airstrikes and airspace violations. The ministry handed the diplomat a formal protest note following attacks on Kandahar, Paktia, and Khost provinces, which reportedly caused civilian casualties.

item.title: Smart water meters based on 5G technology produced in Andijan Technopark
item.description: Smart water meters operating on 5G technology are being produced at the Andijan Technopark in Khojaabad district, Uzbekistan. The facility, a $25 million joint venture with China's Sanchuan company, is fully funded by foreign investment and collaborates with Huawei. Production is 80% robotized, with plans to localize components by 2030.

item.title: Lithuania Temporarily Halts Acceptance of Labor Migrants from Tajikistan
item.description: Lithuania has temporarily suspended the acceptance of applications for work and entry for citizens of Tajikistan. This decision is attributed to an increase in labor migrants from Central Asia. The Migration Department cited a rise in citizens from Tajikistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan arriving in Lithuania.

item.title: Uzbekistan Explores Processing Hazardous Waste in Cement Kilns
item.description: Uzbekistan is examining the possibility of processing certain types of hazardous waste in cement kilns. Representatives from the UN's FAO, the Agency for the Development of Waste Management and Circular Economy, and the cement industry discussed this potential. The technology is used in other countries for waste treatment.

item.title: Uzbekistan Central Bank to Launch Digital Sum by End of 2029
item.description: Uzbekistan's Central Bank plans to introduce the digital sum by the end of 2029. This electronic currency will be used exclusively for wholesale payments. The initiative aims to provide continuous oversight of budget funds, facilitating financing for state procurements, infrastructure projects, and subsidies.

item.title: Tajikistan to Abolish Visa Regime with Three Countries
item.description: The government of Tajikistan is planning to abolish the visa regime with three countries. The project involves agreements to eliminate visa requirements for holders of diplomatic, service, and ordinary passports with Mongolia and Slovakia, among others.

item.title: Court Orders White House to Restore Press Credentials for CNN, MS NOW, Politico
item.description: A federal court has ordered the Trump administration to immediately reinstate White House press credentials for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico. The judge ruled that the administration revoked the credentials without due process and failed to adequately justify the ban on national security grounds.

item.title: Russian National Guard Director Visits Bishkek, Meets Interior Minister
item.description: The Director of Russia's National Guard, Viktor Zolotov, is visiting Kyrgyzstan at the head of a delegation. He met with the Minister of Internal Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic. The visit involves the Federal Service of National Guard Troops of Russia.

item.title: Nine Kazakh Servicemen Dead After Caspian Sea Exercise Incident
item.description: Kazakhstan's Defense Ministry reported that 19 servicemen were swept away by the Caspian Sea during naval exercises on September 24. Nine have been confirmed dead, and three were rescued. Bad weather and strong winds caused the incident. A criminal case has been initiated.

item.title: Afghan UN Envoy Condemns Taliban Entry into Hamid Karzai's Residence
item.description: Naseer Ahmad Faiq, Afghanistan's UN envoy, condemned the Taliban's entry into former president Hamid Karzai's home and restrictions on visitors. He stated that Afghanistan cannot be governed by force and that Karzai has the right to dignity, security, and free expression. Faiq stressed national dialogue and an inclusive political process as the way out of the crisis.

item.title: Peshawar High Court Halts Deportation of 17 Afghan Doctors
item.description: The Peshawar High Court has temporarily blocked the arrest or deportation of 17 Afghan doctors undergoing specialized training in Pakistan. The court allowed them to continue their training until their visa extension applications are processed. Notices were issued to the federal government and the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council regarding the doctors' petition.

item.title: MVD Academy Improves Educational Processes Following Presidential Decree
item.description: The Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD) Academy is enhancing its educational processes based on a presidential decree aimed at transforming professional training for law enforcement. New approaches are being implemented, including a modern educational cluster, a "School" system, and a credit-modular learning system. Practical connections are strengthened by assigning cadets to departments from their first year.

item.title: US dollar strengthens against Uzbek soum, Central Bank announces rates
item.description: The US dollar has strengthened again in Uzbekistan. The Central Bank of Uzbekistan has announced the official exchange rates for foreign currencies against the Uzbek soum, effective September 25. The exact rates were not detailed in the provided text.

item.title: Iranian plane diverted from Dushanbe due to US sanctions, airspace bans
item.description: An Iranian airline flight bound for Dushanbe was forced to return to Tehran after Turkmenistan denied airspace access, and other neighboring countries followed suit due to US sanctions. The flight was operated by Varsh Airlines, recently sanctioned by the US Treasury Department.

item.title: Experience of 'Diyqan Arna' mahalla to be implemented nationwide
item.description: During President Mirziyoyev's visit to Karakalpakstan, infrastructure improvements in mahallas were reviewed. The president visited the 'Diyqan Arna' mahalla, observing a beekeeping cluster. He emphasized developing the sector, ensuring employment, and increasing household incomes, noting beekeeping's profitability and potential for family involvement.

item.title: Afghan leader warns Taliban against persecuting Hazaras, citing historical precedent
item.description: Mohammad Karim Khalili, leader of the Islamic Unity Party of Afghanistan, warned the Taliban against actions targeting Hazara and Shia Muslims. He referenced historical persecution by former king Abdul Rahman, stating the Taliban cannot destroy the Hazara people. Khalili highlighted ongoing discrimination, confiscation of property, and restrictions faced by the Hazara community.

item.title: ADB forecasts Tajikistan's economy to grow 7% in 2026, 6.5% in 2027
item.description: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) projects Tajikistan's economy to grow by 7% in 2026 and 6.5% in 2027, according to its September Asian Development Outlook. The ADB also forecasts inflation in Tajikistan to be 4.5% in 2026 and 4.7% in 2027.

item.title: Uzbek banker Kahramonjon Olimov placed on international wanted list
item.description: Uzbek financier and Anorbank shareholder Kahramonjon Olimov has been placed on Interpol's international wanted list. While his Red Notice has been published, the specific charges or the requesting country are not detailed in the Interpol notice.

item.title: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev Addresses Poverty and Unemployment in Andijan
item.description: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev expressed concern over poverty, unemployment, and migration in the Andijan region, stating he could not rest peacefully in Tashkent knowing these issues. He discussed the problems facing the region's population during a visit.

item.title: Uzbekistan to Open New Border Post 'Keskanyor' with Kyrgyzstan
item.description: Uzbekistan plans to open the 'Keskanyor' border post, twice the size of 'Dostlik', with Kyrgyzstan. An agreement has been reached, with project development and construction to begin within three months. This aims to triple cargo volume and halve transit times. Additionally, construction of a paid Tashkent-Andijan highway is slated to start in 2027.

item.title: Tajikistan and China to Expand Cooperation in Science and Technology
item.description: Tajikistan and China held a working meeting to discuss scientific and technological cooperation, including joint initiatives within the 'One Belt, One Road' and SCO frameworks. Key areas include water resources, ecology, climate change, and digital technologies. Both sides explored possibilities for joint research projects and academic exchanges.

item.title: Uzbekistan to Subsidize Cotton Sales on Exchange, Support Exporters
item.description: Uzbekistan will provide a 500,000 soum subsidy per ton for cotton sold on the exchange to both farmers and buyers. Additional subsidies will be offered for cotton cultivation per hectare and for interest on export credits. Measures are also planned to support fruit and vegetable processing.

item.title: Former Bishkek Deputy Mayor Azamat Kadyrov Detained Until November 20
item.description: Former Bishkek Deputy Mayor Azamat Kadyrov has been placed in pretrial detention until November 20. Kadyrov, who oversaw land use, architecture, construction, and digitalization, served as deputy mayor since November 2023. The specific charges against him are not yet known.

item.title: New 'Keskaner' Border Crossing to Appear Between Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan
item.description: A new 'Keskaner' border crossing, twice the size of 'Dustlik', will be established between Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan. This is expected to triple cargo traffic and reduce border crossing times. The project is linked to increased transport flows, including the planned China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway.

item.title: China and Russia Account for Over Half of Kyrgyzstan's Trade Turnover
item.description: In January-July 2026, Kyrgyzstan's foreign trade turnover exceeded $10 billion. China and Russia remain the primary economic partners, contributing over 60% of the total trade volume. Exports grew significantly in July, driven by precious metals and textiles, with Russia being the largest buyer.

item.title: 19 Kazakh servicemen swept away at Caspian Sea training exercise
item.description: Nineteen Kazakh servicemen were swept away during a training exercise near the Caspian Sea coast. Nine individuals have died, and three have been rescued. The incident occurred during drills on the Caspian Sea shore.

item.title: Money changer killed by unidentified gunmen in Afghanistan's Ghazni province
item.description: Local sources reported that a money changer, identified as Gulbuddin, was shot dead by unknown gunmen in the Wali Dad village of Qarabagh district, Ghazni province. The man was inside his vehicle when the attack occurred. His father reportedly works for the Taliban police headquarters in Ghazni.

item.title: Former Bishkek Vice Mayor Detained Until November 20
item.description: Former Bishkek Vice Mayor Azamat Kadyrov has been placed in pre-trial detention until November 20. The decision was made by the Bishkek City Court, and he will remain in the GKNB pre-trial detention center pending the investigation's conclusion.

item.title: Nine Kazakh Servicemembers Drown During Caspian Sea Military Exercises
item.description: Nine Kazakh military personnel died after being swept away by a wave during naval exercises on the Caspian Sea in the Mangystau region on September 24. The incident occurred during drills conducted by the Kazakh Armed Forces' Navy. Tengrinews.kz reported the event.

item.title: Tajikistan Presents Approaches to Labor Migration at Budapest Process Conference
item.description: Tajikistan participated in the 'Budapest Process' conference in Islamabad, focusing on legal migration pathways, migrant rights, and improved migration management. A representative from Tajikistan's Migration Service presented information on cooperation with the International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD).

item.title: Former Afghan President Karzai Condemns Pakistani Airstrikes as Aggression
item.description: Former Afghan President Hamid Karzai condemned recent Pakistani airstrikes on Kandahar, Khost, and Paktia provinces as "aggression." He urged Pakistan to pursue good neighborly relations and called for more civilized interactions. The strikes reportedly killed four civilians, and the Taliban also condemned the attacks.

item.title: Tajikistan Defense Minister Demands Quality Autumn Conscription
item.description: Tajikistan's Defense Minister, Colonel General Emomali Sobirzoda, has called for a high-quality autumn conscription drive. The directive was issued during a methodological training meeting focused on preparing for the conscription of citizens into the armed forces. Favorable service conditions were also highlighted.

item.title: UN General Assembly Discusses Artificial Intelligence Risks and Control
item.description: Artificial intelligence was a key topic at the UN General Assembly's 81st session, with world leaders warning about autonomous weapons, disinformation, and job losses. Disagreements emerged on control, with the US favoring competition and others calling for international rules and state oversight.

item.title: Andijan to Establish Special Fund for Women's Employment with $20 Million
item.description: A special fund will be established in Andijan to ensure women's employment, with $20 million allocated. This initiative aims to create separate financial and organizational opportunities for women's employment in the region.

item.title: Regional Competition for Female Civil Servants Held in Dangara District
item.description: A regional tour of the Republican Competition 'Best Female Civil Servant' took place in Dangara district on September 22, 2026. Participants were assessed on political knowledge, legal education, professional skills, and communication etiquette, reflecting state policy to enhance women's role in public service.
